local_articles.title: Premier League champions Arsenal land Newcastle’s Bruno Guimaraes
local_articles.snippet: Arsenal have signed Newcastle United captain Bruno Guimaraes on a four-year contract with a further one-year option, the English Premier League champions announced on Aug 8. The North London club have agreed a deal reported by British media to be worth around £75 million (S$129.3 million) for the Brazil international, adding one of the Premier League’s most influential midfielders to Mikel Arteta’s squad. “Since the first time I spoke to (Arsenal sporting director Andrea) Berta and Mikel, I was excited. I just felt inside of me that I need a new challenge in my life and I think to be an Arsenal player is going to be an exciting challenge in my life,” Guimaraes said in a statement on the club’s website. “I am so excited to start. questions.background: Djokovic has won three Cincinnati singles titles, most recently in 2023. The tournament is a major hard-court event leading up to the US Open.
questions.resolution_criteria: Source of Truth : Official Cincinnati Open or ATP Tour match results for the 2026 tournament. Resolution : Resolve when Djokovic records a men's singles defeat at the tournament, using the identity of his winning opponent. If Djokovic wins the title or withdraws without losing a match, the question is void. Accepted Answer Format : The winning opponent's full name.
questions.current_reasoning: This market is conditional on 39-year-old World No. 8 Novak Djokovic playing and losing a match at the 96-player Cincinnati Masters 1000 (void if he wins or withdraws). As a projected #5-#9 seed, Djokovic faces a large share of loss risk in R2-R4 against the broader field, while conditional late-round defeats concentrate on dominant hard-court top seeds Jannik Sinner (No. 1), defending Cincinnati champion Carlos Alcaraz (No. 2, expected back from wrist injury), former winner Alexander Zverev (No. 3), and top-5 big servers Ben Shelton (No. 5) and Felix Auger-Aliassime (No. 4). The top five properly capture ~41% of conditional loss probability, leaving ~59% across the rest of the 95-player draw.
